name: ExcelApplication
label: Excel Application
description: The Excel Application object containing the target worksheet.

name: ValueToWrite
label: Value To Write
description: The value (text or DataTable) to write into the specified cell or range.

name: WriteMode
label: Write Mode
description: Specifies how to determine the target cell(s) for writing.

selectOptions.label: On Specified Cell
selectOptions.description: Writes to a specific cell by column and row.

selectOptions.label: On Currently Active Cell
selectOptions.description: Writes to the currently active cell.

name: Column
label: Column
description: The column letter (e.g., 'A', 'B') where the data should be written (used if ColumnIndex is not provided).

name: ColumnIndex
label: Column Index
description: The index of the column (e.g., 1 for 'A'). Takes precedence if greater than 0.

name: Row
label: Row
description: The row number where the data should be written (required if 'Write Mode' is 'On Specified Cell').

name: Name
label: Name
description: The name of the named range to write to (required if 'Write Mode' is 'On Named Cells').

name: PopulateEntireRange
label: Populate Entire Range
description: If true, populates the entire named range with the same value.
